risk_note: RV2 (orders/**, app.module.ts). Claim evidence in the submission transaction (BR-ATTR-18 / BR-ID-18): strong / weak / none per sub-order from link_logs of the same app, user and platform within W_backfill (default 360 h; non-integer settings count as unset), product key derived from the goods id via platforms.key_prefix when the column is empty, relation_conflict / binding_blocked excluded; claim_items.evidence and evidence_link_log_ids; the claim moves to auto_matched / manual_review by the weakest item through transitionClaim(); evidence read errors roll back the claim and the stored response; production wiring injects the evidence port; logs carry no link_log ids. Stacked on B1-10b and landed right after it (ruling D10-72 A).
